description: Defines the IndexModel class for the Razor Page, handling catalog item retrieval and view model setup for the index page of an e-commerce web app.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: PageModel class for the Index page, responsible for initializing and populating the catalog view model.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, asynchronously fetching catalog items based on page ID and filters, and updating the CatalogModel property.
